name: Critter Kitchen

categories.label: Challenge meal stars (days 1 and 2)
categories.labelVi: Sao từ món thử thách (ngày 1 và 2)
categories.hint: Per challenge meal presented (3 per day, 6 total): quality 6-11 = 1 star, 12-20 = 2 stars, 21+ = 4 stars. Under 6 = no meal. Enter how many meals fell in each tier.

categories.label: Most soup and bisque value
categories.hint: 1 star for highest total value of soup and bisque; ties are friendly (all tied get it).

categories.label: All 7 courses on critic plate
categories.hint: 1 star if you have an ingredient for all 7 courses.

categories.label: Best course quality
categories.hint: 1 star per course where your quality is highest; ties are friendly.

categories.label: Rumor stars
categories.hint: Stars from the 3 rumors scored at the critic meal (Fanatic rumors modify course quality instead, count them in the track total).

categories.label: Bonus scoring stars (critic/restaurateur cards)
categories.hint: Stars at the top of cards with the Bonus Scoring icon (critic card, restaurateur).

categories.label: Critic track: times passing 70
categories.labelVi: Số lần vượt mốc 70 trên track
categories.hint: +10 stars each time your mouse passes the 70 space (continue from the top of the track).

categories.label: Critic meal track: final row stars
categories.labelVi: Sao theo hàng cuối trên track
categories.hint: Stars printed on the row of your score track (kitchen board, scoring side) where your mouse ends after totalling critic-plate quality. Read from board.

categories.label: Score track progress (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí trên track điểm (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Tiebreak: who progressed furthest on the score track.

tiebreakers.description: Player who progressed furthest on their score track
Still tied: whoever is ahead on the priority track wins

notes: family: auction-money (worker placement shopping + star scoring). Winner has most stars after the critic meal at the end of round 7; all scoring ties are friendly (every tied player gets full stars). Verified from rulebook pp.15-18: challenge stars 6-11=1, 12-20=2, 21+=4. The quality-to-stars table of the score track (final row stars) is printed on the kitchen board, so criticTrackRow is a scorer input; trackPosition is the same position used for the tiebreak. Fanatic rumors and critic cards change course quality and are not itemised. Solo vs McDogald's not modelled.
